frontMatter.title: Don't Miss Out! AGM TONIGHT at 8pm in Claremont Stadium
frontMatter.summary: Join us tonight at 8pm in Claremont Stadium for the Navan Badminton Club AGM. Have your say in the future of the club and help us kick off a fantastic new season!

prev.title: Week 10 of Summer Club: The Grand Finale!
prev.summary: Join us tonight at Claremont Stadium from 8pm to 11pm for the grand finale of Summer Club Week 10. Enjoy three hours of fun and games for just €8! Stay tuned for updates on our regular season return.
